title: Titanium Suspension Tie Rod
function: Race suspension double-ended adjustable tie rod
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is selected for Titanium Suspension Tie Rod where unsprung mass reduction directly improves suspension response and lap times. The 45% density reduction vs steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at equivalent strength enables rod and link components to meet fatigue targets >10^6 cycles under dynamic racing loads. Elastic energy storage per unit mass (σ²/2Eρ = 18.5 kJ/kg) is 2.3× that of 4130 steel — optimal for Race suspension double-ended adjustable tie rod. This rationale is driven by race suspension double-ended adjustable tie rod and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for suspension geometry
Shot peening Almen with 0.5mm corner radius
Black oxide/DLC coating with 0.5mm corner radius
CMM SPC dimensional check with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for race suspension doubleended application
commonFailures: Fatigue crack at thread-shank transition - prevented by larger fillet R0.5->1.5mm + cold rolling — critical for race suspension doubleended performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Suspension Tie Rod offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For race suspension doubleended, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Suspension Tie Rod orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Suspension Tie Rod is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Suspension Tie Rod?
faq.a: Each Titanium Suspension Tie Rod shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for race suspension doubleended.
